Name: Slime Sauce
Author: xy177
Description:
Have you ever had the trouble that the petrifield slime produced byyour farmed Slime have no practical effect? Then it will solve yourtroubles!

Petrified slime can now be used to make slimesauce(a pleasant and useful food), or they can be used with slime eggs of different colors or prismatic shard to make other kinds of slimesauce. Their prices will vary with the prices of raw materials(1000/2100/2900/3850/6400/6500), you need a mayonnaise machine to make them.

At the same time, four kinds of slime soft candy are added(The recipe needs to be purchased from Gus.), which have the same buff effect but shorter duration, but can better matchwith mods like [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/522]Cooking Skill
[/url]
This mod needs Json Assets and the Producer Framework Mod to function.

In the future, I will consider making some other colors or flavors of Slime sauce to make them more diversified.By the way, shoutout to the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7660]Ostrich Mayo and Golden Mayo[/url] mod, which inspired me to make this mod.
